content.short: Rivera Money is a liquidity infrastructure protocol providing automated concentrated liquidity management and risk-sharing for LPs on Mantle.
content.description: Rivera Money is a DeFi protocol that provides intelligent automated management of concentrated liquidity positions on Mantle DEXes, continuously rebalancing LP positions to maximize fee income and minimize impermanent loss through algorithmic strategies. The platform's risk-sharing model distributes the costs and benefits of active management across a pool of liquidity providers, making professional-grade LP management accessible to all users. Rivera is purpose-built for Mantle's concentrated liquidity ecosystem.
